item.title: Poppy Says She Was ‘Unable to Breathe’ Amid Wildfire Smoke at Upheaval Festival
item.description:
[Energetic music fades out, and the host begins speaking]
Host: "Welcome back to Trending on Billboard! I'm your host, [Name], and we've got some news to share with you. Poppy's set at the Upheaval Festival in Grand Rapids, Michigan, took an unexpected turn on Friday night. The reason? Wildfire smoke created hazardous air quality conditions, forcing the singer to cancel her performance."
[Short music transition]
Host: "According to the U.S. Air Quality Index, readings above 300 are classified as hazardous, and on Friday, the AQI reached 350+. That's a serious health warning, folks. Poppy addressed her absence on Instagram Stories, explaining that she simply couldn't breathe in those conditions. Her band, however, still took the stage, delivering an instrumental set while wearing respirator masks."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This isn't the first time Poppy's faced severe conditions during a performance. Back in May, her set at Welcome to Rockville was cut short due to severe weather and lightning protocols. Despite these interruptions, Poppy's still killing it on the Billboard rock charts. Her track 'End of You', featuring Amy Lee and Courtney LaPlante, debuted at number one on the Hot Hard Rock Songs chart and made history on the Mainstream Rock Airplay chart."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Poppy's latest album, Empty Hands, was released in January, and it's been a game-changer for her fans. With production from Jordan Fish and Stephen Harrison, she's continued to push the boundaries of heavy, industrial, and alternative sounds. We're excited to see what's next for this talented artist. That's all for today, folks. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard!"
[Music fades out]
